FIELD NOTES

Reading the album

Two Squeeks of the same level merge. One ID survives and levels up, and the other is burned. Each connection comes from a confirmed merge on Ethereum Sepolia.

For a burned ID, the album reads tokenURI at the block immediately before its merge to recover its original portrait. Open any ledger transaction to check the evidence.
